summary: Shared **v0.2** API contract in `:core`: `@Serializable` DTOs, `MoneyCents` (Long cents ↔ 2-dp JSON euros), `PatchField<T>` (RFC 7386 Merge Patch), enums + Valencian `enumLabels`, shared validation, auth/list primitives, and **MuixerangaApi** (Ktor Client skeleton). **No** `:server` routes, **no** Compose UI.
overview:
Platform slice that turns the empty `:core` module (`GreetingUtil`) into the single JSON contract for `:server` and `:app:shared` / `:app:webApp` (`wasmJs`).

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §5–6, §12.3 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Package layout (normative)**
```text
core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/bitdesal/tabala/
├── model/          # v0.2 entity DTOs + nested value types + Patch DTOs
├── model/enums/    # §5.3 @Serializable enums (MemberStatus uses deleted)
├── api/            # ApiError, PagedResponse, PatchField, MoneyCents, auth/health/export bodies, Permission
├── api/client/     # MuixerangaApi + Ktor HttpClient config
├── validation/     # §6.4 shared rules (pure Kotlin)
└── i18n/           # §12.3 Valencian enum labels (+ ShirtSize, AreaKind)
```

**Serialization & contract rules (`decisiones.md`)**
- Shared `TabalaJson = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; explicitNulls = false }` used by both Ktor server and `MuixerangaApi`.
- **Money (`MoneyCents`):** `@JvmInline value class MoneyCents(val cents: Long)` with custom `KSerializer` encoding/decoding JSON numbers in euros with 2 decimal places (`450.00` ↔ `45000L`, never `Double` arithmetic).
- **RFC 7386 Merge Patch (`PatchField<T>`):** sealed interface `Absent` | `Null` | `Value(val value: T)` with custom serializer so PATCH requests distinguish omitted fields (untouched) from explicit `null` (clear field) even when `explicitNulls = false`.
- **Enums:** `@SerialName("snake_case")` wire values per §5.3, with `MemberStatus` = `active`, `inactive`, `on_leave`, `deleted` (replaces `former`).
- **Dates/times:** `datetime` → `kotlinx.datetime.Instant`; `date` → `kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate`.
- **Derived fields** (`orgRoles`, `vacant`, `totalQuantity`, `lowStock`, `overdue`, `isMinor`, `googleLinked`, etc.): present on response DTOs; omitted on create/patch request DTOs.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :core:compileKotlinJvm :core:compileKotlinWasmJs` succeeds.
- `./gradlew :core:jvmTest` green with round-trip JSON fixtures for every entity, `MoneyCents`, `PatchField`, enums, and validation rules.
- Every §5.3 enum has a Kotlin enum and a Valencian `labelCa()` function (including `ShirtSize`, `AreaKind`, and `MemberStatus.DELETED` → «Eliminat»).
- `MuixerangaApi` compiles on JVM and `wasmJs` with methods for `GET /api/health` and §6.6/§6.7 auth + `/me` endpoints.
- `GreetingUtil.kt` removed.
shared_ui_policy: No Compose in `:core`. `:app:shared` consumes these DTOs and `MuixerangaApi` in web feature slices.
out_of_scope:
- `:server` routes, Koin modules, and SQLDelight mappers.
- `:app:shared` repositories, ViewModels, and Compose UI.
- Android, desktop, and JS-only client tuning (v1 focuses on JVM server + `wasmJs` web).
- Full `MuixerangaApi` resource methods for every SPEC-01..08 endpoint (each feature slice adds its own methods/extension group to `MuixerangaApi`).
- Firebase types or OpenAPI generation.

auth.server: Reuses the exact same `:core` DTOs for JSON encode/decode.

structure:
Shared KMP contract consumed by both `:server` and `:app:shared`:

```text
:server      ──depends on──► :core (DTOs, enums, MoneyCents, PatchField, validators, Permission)
:app:shared  ──depends on──► :core (DTOs, enums, i18n labels, validators, MuixerangaApi)
```

DTO naming convention:
- `Foo`: full resource returned by authenticated GET (audience-specific variants where needed, e.g. `UserSelf`, `UserStaff`, `UserBoard`).
- `FooPublic`: strictly filtered subset for `/api/v1/public/*`.
- `FooCreate`: POST request body (no `id`, `version`, timestamps, or derived fields).
- `FooPatch`: RFC 7386 Merge Patch body with required `version: Int` and `PatchField<T>` properties.
- `PagedResponse<Foo>`: §6.2 pagination envelope (`items`, `page`, `perPage`, `totalItems`, `totalPages`).

sections.title: MoneyCents serialization (`decisiones.md`)
sections.description: Represent monetary amounts as `@Serializable(with = MoneyCentsSerializer::class) @JvmInline value class MoneyCents(val cents: Long)` instead of `Double`.
sections.behavior: Serializer emits an exact JSON number with 2 decimal digits via `JsonUnquotedLiteral` (e.g. `45000L` → `450.00`) and parses JSON numbers (`450`, `450.5`, `450.00`) strictly to integer cents (rejecting >2 decimal places or non-numeric strings with `SerializationException`). Reject negative values in validators.

sections.title: PatchField<T> for RFC 7386 Merge Patch
sections.description: Every optional field in `*Patch` DTOs uses `PatchField<T>` defaulting to `PatchField.Absent`. Explicit JSON `null` deserializes to `PatchField.Null` (clear value); a non-null JSON value deserializes to `PatchField.Value(v)`.
sections.behavior: Custom serializer + `TabalaJson` omits `Absent` keys when encoding from client, writes explicit `null` for `PatchField.Null`, and writes the encoded value for `PatchField.Value`. On the server, services apply updates only for non-`Absent` fields, preventing accidental wipes.

sections.title: Value types and permissions (§6.1.1)
sections.description: Include `FileRef(id, url, thumbUrl?, contentType, size)`, `GeoPoint(latitude, longitude)`, `PostalAddress`, `EmergencyContact`, `UserConsent`, `UserAccount`, `UserGuardian`, `OrgRoleSummary`, `UserPositionSummary`, `SocialLinks`, `ContractClient`, `ContractContact`, `ContractGrant`, `ContractBilling`, `InventoryVariant`, `AttendanceSummary`.
sections.behavior: Expose `Permission` string constants matching all 21 rows in §6.1.1 plus `permissionsForRole(role: AccountRole): Set<String>` so server (`GET /me`) and client navigation share a single source of truth.

sections.title: Enum labels in Valencian (§12.3)
sections.description: Provide `labelCa(): String` for all 20 enums in §5.3.

persistence: None in `:core`. Types mirror SQLite v0.2 semantics (`MoneyCents` maps 1:1 to `INTEGER` cents columns).
